spec.query: SELECT status_code, status FROM "ups_status" WHERE status_code != 1 AND $timeFilter
SELECT mean("battery_charge") FROM "ups_status" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("input_voltage") FROM "ups_status" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT mean("ups_load") FROM "ups_status" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT status, status_code, battery_charge FROM "ups_status" WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT sum("elapsed")/60 FROM (
  SELECT elapsed("status_code", 1s) AS "elapsed" 
  FROM "ups_status" 
  WHERE status_code = 2 AND $timeFilter
)
